title: Editorial
summary: A clean, modern magazine look whose colours are measured on the footage itself: cool daylight paper, aubergine ink, the wine red of a plaid jacket and warm skin blush. A condensed high-contrast serif (Instrument Serif) with its italic for the one word that matters, a Didone (Bodoni Moda) for mastheads and big numerals, small widely tracked Inter Tight capitals, DM Mono folios. Thin rules, folios, issue numbers, pull quotes, drop caps, a 12-column grid and generous margins. Smooth, precise motion: text rises from behind a hairline, rules draw, paper cards glide and settle, letters fade up, soft focus pulls and glides between pictures. Nothing bounces, flashes or glows. Original work in the genre of editorial design.
